svg.title: That's my Egg! keyboard bindings
svg.desc: 104-key US ANSI keyboard. Coloured keys have game, contextual, developer or native bindings. Grey keys have no project binding found. Spare letters: J, K, Y, Z.

g.text: Current source audit, 8 November 2026 | US ANSI layout

g.title: 1: Select hotbar slot; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
2: Select hotbar slot; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
3: Select hotbar slot; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
4: Select hotbar slot; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18

6: Select hotbar slot; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
7: Select hotbar slot; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
8: Select hotbar slot; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
9: Select hotbar slot; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
Backspace: Native tool drop / edit text
Q: Unequip held item; Rotate placed house item left / right; Admin free-camera movement
W: Move; Admin flight movement; Admin free-camera movement
E: Interact / primary action; Rotate placed house item left / right; Admin free-camera movement
R: Praise pet / eat or drink held food
A: Move; Admin flight movement; Admin free-camera movement
S: Move; Admin flight movement; Admin free-camera movement
D: Move; Admin flight movement; Admin free-camera movement
H: Stop following pet; Restore hidden admin camera controls
Shift: Hold for running boost; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
N: Open held Boom Box music
Shift: Hold for running boost; Choose emote 1 to 9 / 10 to 18
Ctrl: Swim downward; Admin flight movement; Admin free-camera movement; Hold to hide
Space: Jump / swim up / Turbo Boost; Admin flight movement; Admin free-camera movement
Ctrl: Swim downward; Admin flight movement; Hold to hide

g.text: Unassigned letter candidates: J K Y Z
Grey means no project binding found. Roblox, system shortcuts and typing may still use a key.
Shared keys depend on context. Read the wiki table for exact actions, restrictions and source references.
